summary: Alibaba Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K furnishing an announcement to the Hong Kong Stock Exchange giving notice of a board meeting date. The board will meet to discuss and approve unaudited results for the three and six months ended September 30, 2026, with the results announcement scheduled for November 19, 2026. No transaction, stake, price, premium, or advisor is disclosed. The filing is a routine meeting notice and dual-listed ADS/share reminder, not a special situation; no deal terms, recommendation, or risk-arb angle apply.
